decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot remains a core part of the automated plant offer, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall to trigger search, although some risk remains that it is consolidated with the single-function robots.
The de-shuttering robot is a standard module in integrated precast lines, and the slack from growth lets the firm carry it while its results are still uncertain.
The automatic shuttering robot is central to the firm's automation strategy and fits its engineering strengths, so results meet aspiration and it stays.

The magazining, cleaning and plotting machine line was only launched in 2024 and has several models that complete the robotic circulation plant, so the firm will give it time before judging it against aspirations.
The production analysis software supports the firm's digital and lifecycle-service strategy at low carrying cost and strengthens customer lock-in, so there is no reason to drop it.
